source.titleFrom: running head printed on scan p.24 (廣東財政紀實 第四編 會計 第三章 預算); the scan is the National Library of China copy
source.renderSha256From: provenance.renderSha256 of this book's sealed pages in jyut-ocr-corpus and ~/ocr-runs, measured 2026-09-24: each page the assertions name has one hash across its 19 sealed output(s); an all-cases run skips this case when every recorded page of the output has another hash (another book's page); pp.25-29 added 2026-09-25 as sha256 of jyut-ocr-corpus/nlc-finance/renders/page-00NN.png (the same method reproduces the recorded p.24 hash)

assertions.note: user golden 2026-09-25 (canvas 'Merged Tables', artifact USiJ9F3Q2KKwYU16kjxKpM, accepted without changes): the 歲入預算 table printed across pp.24-29 is ONE table and the output must write it merged (user 2026-09-25: 'We are testing this exact ability of recognizing a cross-page big table'). Oriented like golden-24-h1 before it: one record per year as rows, 年度 + 17 categories + 合計 as columns (the transpose of the printed grid, where years are columns); rows 元年度 and 二年度 are page-0024.md verbatim. 16 year rows: 元-十 and 十六-二十一 (十一-十五 are not printed; p.27 goes 九, 十, 十六). Row labels print only on p.24; later pages line up by position. p.29 holds two tables: only its right half (二十, 二十一年度) belongs here; its left half starts the 歲出預算 table (continued on p.30), which is not part of this golden. 十八年度's figures sum to 60,760,883 but its printed 合計 is 六〇、七六〇、七〇三: a misprint in the source, kept as printed. Prefill: blind per-page transcription by subagents, checked against both engines and every year's sum, then an adversarial row-placement check (jyut-ocr-corpus/runs/merged-table). Replaces golden-24-h1 (page-0024.md, p.24 alone), which would fail a correctly merged output.

assertions.value: user (as relayed 2026-09-24): transposition (a printed column is a record and becomes a row) is common but not universal. The orientation of each table must come from evidence on the page - totals that reconcile, where the labels stand - not from a rule that vertical books always transpose.
p.29 starts a second table (（乙）民國元年度至二十一年度廣東財政歲出預算, title and row labels on its left half); it continues on p.30 and is outside this case. Its presence on p.29 must not be merged into the 歲入 table.
